organizations.publicNote: Vienna music publisher founded in spring 1933 by Erwin Hein together with Universal Edition. It specialized in popular song, sound-film and operetta publishing and operated at Bösendorferstraße 12. No matching formal GND or VIAF corporate authority has been identified.

sources.fullCitation: Walter Jurmann and B. Kaper, Abenteuer am Lido, film songs “Adieu, es ist zu schön, um wahr zu sein” (tango) and “Wie schön ist diese Welt” (slow foxtrot); words by F. Rotter; arrangements for salon orchestra with jazz parts by A. Steinbrecher, with a complete edition for voice and piano. Vienna I, Bösendorferstraße 12: Dacapo-Verlag, 1933. Registered in Hofmeisters Musikalisch-literarischer Monatsbericht 105, no. 11 (November 1933): 213. ANNO – Austrian Newspapers Online, Österreichische Nationalbibliothek.
